# Lessons Log — v1.0-brownfield-backfill

## L-EDP1-010 — Use bold-prefix for Closes lines, not h3 headings

Category: process
Date: 2026-04-05

Lesson: the canonical Closes annotation form is `**Closes:**` bold-prefix, not a `### Closes`
h3 section heading. Using an h3 heading violates D-448(b) and will not be recognised by the
validate-closes-completeness hook.

### Closes

D-444
